chapter: The jazz war with Leonard Feather
title: Feather's personal attacks had no truth
summary: Hodes says the political charges had no veracity, though he admits to women, pot and drink. He asks why Feather never wrote that he jammed with Lester Young.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah, but apparently part of the
arsenal that the -- Leonard and the others used to get you, it was a personal attack, almost.

Yeah, it had no veracity. If they'd said that I like girls, he had something. If he said that I smoked pot, he had something. I smoked a lot of pot, I loved it. If he said I drank, fine, when I could get ahold of it, yes. This, he had something. This is true.
But to say -- why didn't he say that I jammed with Pres, Lester Young? Why didn't he say that?
